scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd .. && sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default/uiBundles/RevenueConfigurator --metadata CustomApplication:RevenueConfigurator --ignore-conflicts
scripts.open: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const q='SELECT StartUrl FROM AppMenuItem WHERE Name = \'RevenueConfigurator\'';const r=JSON.parse(execSync('sf data query --query \"'+q+'\" --json',{cwd:'..'}).toString());const url=r.result.records[0].StartUrl;execSync('open \"'+url+'\"');console.log('Opened '+url)"
